=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- Multiple files (see [LAST RUN CHANGED FILES]) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run changed an unrelated review-pipeline refactor instead of the PR’s stall-recovery retry logic.
  WHY: The reviewers agree the intended `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` fix is missing while many unrelated files were introduced, and the consensus uses the highest reported severity.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:94-148 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The new review consolidation stages are wired in with fail-open logic that can suppress pipeline errors.
  WHY: If `review_consolidate.sh` fails or is missing, the script warns and proceeds with empty or missing `review_issues.txt`, which can silence real review findings.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5588-5593 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry loop’s settlement check requires `mergeable` to be definitive before breaking, so `merge_state="dirty"` with `mergeable=null` keeps retrying.
  WHY: Reviewers agree this delays conflict resolution by up to 50 seconds even when the conflict is already known, and the highest severity/confidence reported is preserved.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5588-5589 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The retry loop extracts `merge_state_status` differently from the guard logic and omits the fallback to `mergeable_state`.
  WHY: When the API returns only `mergeable_state`, the guard can recognize it but the retry loop treats it as unknown and continues retrying.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5491 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: `jq` failure handling can leave an empty string instead of valid `"null"`.
  WHY: Downstream parsing expects valid JSON, so malformed or failed extraction can make the conflict guard misbehave.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5589-5592 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The surrounding comment says dirty states count as settled, but the code does not actually break on dirty unless mergeable is also definitive.
  WHY: The mismatch can mislead maintainers and mask the early-exit bug in the retry loop.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
